words.definition: 生气；愤怒 vt. 使愤怒；激怒
words.etymology: v. c. 1200, “to irritate, annoy, provoke,” from Old Norse angra “to grieve, n. Mid-13c., “hostile attitude, ill will, surliness”.
examples:
The question clearly angered him.
这个问题显然激怒了他。
words.mnemonic:
ang-（=tight, painful：拉紧的；疼痛的）+ -er（名词 / 动词后缀）→
愤怒时人会容易紧张、并且因为令人恼怒的事情而痛苦→生气，愤

words.definition: 生气的；愤怒的；（海或天空）狂风暴雨的，波涛汹涌的
examples:
Her behavior really made me angry.
她的行为确实令我愤怒。
words.mnemonic: anger（生气；愤怒）+ -y（形容词后缀）→生气的，愤怒的

examples:
Officials reacted angrily to those charges.
官员们愤怒地回应了那些指控。
